verdict.rationale: No evidence describes a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or test mode where AI agents or workflows can be tried without affecting production data; self-hosting via Docker Compose (twenty-docs-10, twenty-docs-26) could theoretically be repurposed to spin up a separate instance, but this is never framed as a sandbox feature and requires manual infrastructure setup rather than a built-in capability. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment, test/demo data seeding, or documented way to run AI agents against non-production data.
